The Lots

Building a Home in Bayview Village

Wide frontages, deep properties, mature tree canopies, quiet streets feeding into Bayview Avenue and the subway line. Most new builds in Bayview Village replace 1950s–70s ranches and bungalows with 5,000–8,000 sq ft custom homes that take full advantage of the lot. The constraint isn’t the land — it’s designing a home that earns its place on the street.

Requirements

Requirements to Build in Bayview Village

Teardown and demolition

▾

Almost every Bayview Village build starts with removing the existing home. We handle demolition permits, environmental screening for older homes, and site hoarding.

Tree protection

▾

Bayview Village’s canopy is part of what makes it. City of Toronto tree bylaws are strict. Arborist reports, tree protection zones, and Parks permits are non-negotiable, we handle them.

Zoning and Committee of Adjustment

▾

Many Bayview Village lots hit setback or height limits. Minor variance applications are common. We manage the full process.

Neighbour considerations

▾

Bayview Village is an engaged community. We prepare for Committee of Adjustment with renders and context that address neighbour concerns before they become objections.

Our Process

Our Process

We believe building a home should be an exciting journey, not a source of stress. As one of the top custom home builders in Toronto, we’ve spent 15 years perfecting a simple, 6-step process that keeps your project on track, on budget, and exactly the way you envisioned it.

01

Consultation

Our process begins with a strategic consultation that helps us align your vision and goals to site feasibility and permit requirements. This meeting also helps us outline the general scope, budget, and timeline expectations of the custom project.

02

Design and Permit

Our design team translates your vision into architectural reality. We develop comprehensive floor plans, elevations, and structural specifications that prioritize both aesthetics and Toronto building code compliance.

03

Cost Estimation

We leverage our wholesale purchasing power to provide a transparent, fixed-cost budget. By dealing directly with manufacturers and cutting out middlemen, we pass savings of up to 30% directly to you. You get total financial clarity on all labor and materials before we break ground.

04

Construction

With approvals and permits in place, construction begins. This phase includes demolition (if applicable), structural work, framing, mechanical systems, and interior/exterior finishes. Progress is monitored closely to ensure quality and adherence to the project plan.

05

Inspection

Comprehensive inspections by our team and relevant authorities to ensure compliance with building codes, safety regulations, and project specifications. We also complete any touch-ups, address outstanding items, and ensure that finishes and fixtures are polished and properly installed.

06

Final Completion and Handover

We meticulously review every aspect to ensure your satisfaction. The final handover process is seamlessly guided, marking the transition of your new home into your possession.
